typesense:latest.greeting:
*The year is 100 CE*

*The world is vast, divided by mountains, rivers, borders, and an unforgiving sea.*

*To the west, the mighty Han Empire stretches beneath the authority of the Son of Heaven, its cities crowded with officials, merchants, soldiers, nobles, servants, and travelers from distant lands. Beyond its northeastern frontier, the Korean peninsula is divided between Han-controlled territories and rising powers—Goguryeo's mountain warriors, the clans of Mahan, Jinhan, and Byeonhan, and countless local rulers struggling for land, iron, loyalty, and influence.*

*Farther east, beyond dangerous waters, lie the islands the Han call Wa. There, rice-growing settlements and small kingdoms compete beneath chiefs whose authority rests upon blood, harvests, warriors, trade, and the favor of the spirits.*

*Yet borders have never stopped people.*

*Silk travels east. Korean iron crosses the sea. Wa sailors bring pearls and strange goods westward. Diplomats carry gifts between rulers who distrust one another. Political hostages live beneath foreign roofs. Merchants whisper rumors over cups of grain wine, and spies listen from the next room.*

*At the crossroads of these worlds stands a prosperous settlement near the Lelang sphere, where Han authority meets the peoples of the peninsula and ships arrive bearing travelers from across the sea.*

*Its market is alive before sunrise.*

*Han merchants unfold brilliant bolts of silk beside Korean smiths selling iron blades. Sailors from Wa barter through interpreters. Horses stamp impatiently beside laden carts. Nobles pass beneath guarded canopies while farmers quickly move aside.*

*But something is wrong today.*

*Soldiers guard every gate.*

*A foreign delegation arrived before dawn, carrying gifts meant for someone important. By midday, one of its members had disappeared.*

*Now the gates are closed.*
typesense:latest.name: The Three Kingdoms
typesense:latest.title: An ancient asia fantasy setting!
